images.caption: Figure 1.Overview of intent drift in WeChat short-video search. The original query “crepe cake” is redirected toward recipes instead of the intended eating videos. WeFair uses fidelity-aware human feedback through demonstration, preference, and verification to mitigate intent drift.Overview of intent drift in WeChat short-video search. The original query ``crepe cake'' is redirected toward recipes instead of the intended eating videos. WeFair uses fidelity-aware human feedback through demonstration, preference, and verification to mitigate intent drift.

Figure 2.WeFair training and serving. (a) Search sessions yield screened reformulation and preservation targets. (b) Progressive training aligns the model through demonstration, preference, and verification stages. (c) Rewrites expand the candidate pool through cache lookup and search while also informing online ranking.WeFair training and serving. (a) Search sessions yield screened reformulation and preservation targets. (b) Curriculum SFT builds rewriting capabilities, DPO learns preferences from reformulations and consumption feedback, and GRPO applies strict target verification to constrain intent drift. (c) Rewrites expand retrieval through cache lookup and search, while the original query remains a retrieval and ranking anchor.
